# GorillaNotifications template

Source: https://github.com/hamburbur-org/Gorilla-Notifications

The `gnotifications` bundle comes from that project. PrimalCraft uses its WorldSpaceCanvas prefab and JetBrainsMono-ExtraBold font for owner-only VR notices. The included upstream LICENSE is GNU GPL version 2.

The notification placement, eye-facing orientation, message contents, inventory/countdown behavior and lifecycle were adapted for this mod. Replacement source is included in this workspace; no decompiled friend/game source is part of the template adaptation.
